name: TrakSpool Firmware
changes: Redesigned admin console: colours taken from the TrakSpool logo, a sidebar on computers and a tab bar on phones, and no fonts loaded from the internet

Wi-Fi joining reworked: a network that cannot be joined is retried with a growing pause instead of non-stop, so network scans and BLE setup are no longer blocked, and a corrected password now joins from the device screen
BLE setup can be tried again after a failed join, and saving a network on the device switches on Wi-Fi, autojoin and the web console
Tag operations from the web console and the device no longer collide: the device does one tag operation at a time, and the console is told when it is busy
Opening the Tag Spool dialog can no longer leave Autotag switched off; it is now paused only while the dialog is open
The empty-spool weight correction now asks on the device screen and changes the tag only after you confirm
Autotag no longer writes to a tag while the scale is uncalibrated, no longer re-imports a spool it already knows, and reads tags written by other OpenPrintTag tools
Editing a brand, colour or temperature profile keeps the entry's other data, and brands now store their empty-spool weights
Saving to the device is safer against power loss, and a damaged or unusual tag can no longer freeze the device

Admin console: backups now include saved presets, custom material types and your own brands and colours; re-importing a backup no longer duplicates unopened spools and asks before overwriting their quantities; fixes for adding temperature profiles, cancelling a calibration and typing into dropdown fields
